main_text.p: mihi plane conftaret cffe ordinem illicitum vel (quæ audax quorundam fed infirma calumnia eft) Antichriftianum. Cùm verò exquisitissima veritatis exploratione habita magis indics magisque confirmor in æ[?]quitate & pietate eorum in quæ juraverim, certè nemo, nisi qui animæ meæ perniciem struit, in hæc duo tam atrocia scelera, Sacrilegium nempe & Perjurium se hîc invicem trahentia impellat: mitto hîc personales injurias in plurimos de me optimè meritos, qui haud minore Iure suis gaudent fortunis, quàm, qui Illos privare student propriis suis patrimoniis, quinque nulla adhuc lege convicti sunt eorum criminum, ob quæ prædiis suis & Bonis cæteris mulctari merentur.

Sæpe equidem demiratus sum istos homines magnam Confcientiæ teneritudinem & Re-formandi studium præ se ferentes, id mihi velle persuadere, me Iuramento Coronationis meæ obstrictum in quæcunque ab illis proposita consentire debere (quod vehementer urgent) utcunque Rationis & Religionis libertati contraria, (quam certè tueri omnes debent, & de qua Ipsi in suffragiis suis tam impensè cavent) eodem simul tempore affirmantes irritum me facere oportere, & aperte violare illam partem Iuramenti, qua, secundum optimum Rationis & Religionis lumen, Regimen Ecclesiæ, & Legitima ejus Iura tueri obstringor. page.notes: Short dark marks in the left margin beside "meritos" and "ne," (a dot or tick) appear to be printer's marks or ink specks, not reference signs; no note text is printed in either margin. "æ[?]quitate": the word is set with a ligature that is hard to read; likely "æquitate". Running head Greek is read as ΒΑΣΙΑΙΚΗ as printed. The line "anima-" ends the page mid-word, so the text continues on the next page.
